headline.zh: 嘉善路临街大玻璃窗咖啡馆

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃窗，采光良好
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows provide ample natural light

traits.zh: 吧台座位，顾客坐在吧台前使用电脑
traits.en: Counter seating with customers working on laptops

traits.zh: 菜单标有饮品价格，如20元、25元
traits.en: Drink prices listed on menu, e.g., ¥20, ¥25

traits.zh: 店内有绿植装饰，墙边摆放盆栽
traits.en: Indoor greenery with potted plants along walls

focus.en: Counter seating used for laptop work

linger.zh: 顾客坐吧台用电脑久留
linger.en: Customers linger at counter with laptops
